plan.title: Cart contents after checkout and adding a second product
plan.description: Add the keyboard to the cart, complete checkout, then add the mouse and check the cart item count reported in the navigation reflects only the newly added product.
preconditions: The shop page at / loads with the product list and an empty cart (Cart (0)).

steps.description: The cart link shows zero items when the page loads.
After adding the keyboard the cart link shows one item.
After checking out, the cart link shows zero items again.
After the checkout, adding the mouse should leave exactly one item in the cart.

metadata.symptom: I bought a keyboard and then kept shopping. When I added a mouse, the keyboard I had already paid for appeared in my cart again.
